requirements.description: Independent mainnet source-to-Wasm, code/metadata/version and supported capability approval
Owned mainnet route attestation, archive capability and independently corroborated finalized identity
Final testnet report preserving R48 failure and the actual completed scope
Disposition of every testnet exception; no provisional testnet authority inherited
Exact composed binary/contract/server release and controlled production-path rehearsal results
Bytecode, ABI, constructor arguments, deployment origins/nonces, expected addresses and custody getter proofs
Exact miner, validator, operator, root-service and monitor executable/config/image identities
Qualified server migration order, schema/writer compatibility and revision-fenced writer cutover
Public owner/deployer/Safe/guardian/oracle/pool/escrow/provider identities, two distinct UR validators, and separate netuid-0 role
Bounded signer/coldkey/Safe custody adapters, permissions, single-writer leases and durable nonce/receipt ownership
Integer fee/value/stake/registration/lifetime ceilings, collateral exposure and validity windows; no inherited testnet budgets
Exact SN25 generation and both mapping directions; removal/preservation hotkey generations, residual stake and capacity
Supported reset method and actual authorized origin; prove pruning/removal targets, immunity, renumbering and preserved roles
Bounded pool/escrow/head/validator registrations with identities, actual costs and complete postconditions
Existing netuid-0 hotkey/coldkey seat generation, eligibility, stake/retention, delegation and basket policy; no assumed seat or unbounded registration
Two independent UR identities with current permits, effective stake, CRv4 policy and revealed/applied row evidence
Two healthy operators and authenticated domains; root-only membership cannot count toward UR quorum
Independent root/UR services with complete child joining, durable state, config hashes and bounded restart/rollout
Independent reconciliation, delivered alert tests, primary/backup on-call and bounded repair/rollback policy
Runtime-qualified 10% native miner target through actual Yuma outcomes and quantization; weight scaling alone is insufficient
Owner-hotkey path, finalized Recycle mode and realized 90% remainder accounting with no reserve credit
Signed UR policy and equal paid/free completed-byte attribution with durable usage, source continuity and settlement proofs
Fresh finalized native boundary and exact admitted policy/capability generation after setup completes
Production interval, settlement/claim reconciliation, observed 10% outcome tolerance and terminal evidence predicates

actions.description: Review exact source, artifacts and production qualification
Establish network, public roles, custody and bounded authority
Reset only approved SN25 miner generations and prove protected identities survive
Deploy exact custody graph and prove code, ownership and constructor state
Register approved pool, escrow, miner and UR-validator generations
Run the separate netuid-0 role only for an approved existing seat and strategy
Admit both independent UR validators and the two-operator safety quorum
Start independent monitoring and verify alert/repair ownership
Activate 10% of native miner allocation and recycle the remaining 90% through the owner path
Observe actual production outcomes, settle accrued value and publish complete evidence

execution_blockers: Supply independently approved mainnet chain/genesis/EVM964 and exact snapshot/source-lock/release inputs before building a bound review
All actions need their missing semantic capability/custody/role/artifact validators and a separate executable plan authorization
